home.heroEyebrow: Jabal Al Akhdar · 2,000 m above the sea
home.heroTitle: A quiet stay at the edge of the canyon
home.heroSubtitle: Rooms, suites and chalets on Oman's Green Mountain — cool air, big skies and no online payment. Book direct and pay when you arrive.
home.heroImageAlt: The canyon below Sama Hotel in Jabal Al Akhdar at golden hour

altitude.title: Views from 2,000 m
altitude.body: Every room faces either the canyon and the sunset or Sayq village and the sunrise.

peek.title: The Peek coffee shop
peek.body: Speciality coffee on the terrace above the canyon, open 07:00–22:00 every day.

season.title: Pomegranate & rose season
season.body: Rose water in April, pomegranates from September — the terraces are a short walk away.

cool.title: 10–15 °C cooler than Muscat
cool.body: Clear skies for stargazing at night and a jumper in the evening, even in summer.

pool.title: Pool & jacuzzi on the cliff
pool.body: An outdoor pool and jacuzzi right on the edge, with a children's pool beside it.

home.roomsIntro: From a deluxe room for two to a chalet with its own garden. Prices are per night, taxes shown separately.
home.roomsUnavailable: Room details are not available right now. Please call or WhatsApp us and we will help you book.
home.locationBody: Sama Hotel is in Sayq, Jabal Al Akhdar, in the Ad Dakhiliyah governorate. Take the road through Nizwa and Birkat Al Mouz, then the climb up the mountain — the last stretch is the best part of the drive.
home.fourWdBody: The police checkpoint at Birkat Al Mouz does not allow two-wheel-drive cars up the mountain. If you do not have a 4WD, park at the checkpoint and message us in advance to arrange a transfer.
home.fuelTip: Fill up in Nizwa or Birkat Al Mouz — it is the last petrol station before the climb.
home.payAtHotelBody: No deposit and no card details online. Your booking is confirmed by email and WhatsApp, and you pay by cash or card when you arrive.

peek.title: Coffee above the canyon
peek.intro: The Peek is our speciality coffee shop on the terrace — the best seat on the mountain for sunrise, sunset and everything in between.
peek.body1: Single-origin espresso, pour-overs, Omani coffee with dates, fresh juices and a short menu of cakes and light bites. In the evening the terrace turns into the quietest spot to watch the lights of Sayq come on.
peek.body2: Open to hotel guests and visitors alike. No reservation needed — arrive early for a seat at the edge on weekends.
peek.imageAlt2: The Peek terrace in the evening

contact.title: We are here to help
contact.intro: For bookings, questions about the road, or anything else — WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach the reservations team.

policies.title: Hotel policies
policies.intro: The short version of how things work at Sama Hotel. If anything is unclear, just ask.
policies.checkTimesBody: Check-in from {checkIn}, check-out by {checkOut}. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability — message us on the day.
policies.childrenBody: Children under {age} stay free in their parents' room using existing bedding. An extra bed is OMR {price} per night, on request. A cot for infants is free.
policies.petsBody: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
policies.smokingBody: All rooms are non-smoking. A shisha area is available outside.
policies.paymentBody: Payment is made at the hotel on arrival, by cash or card. We do not take online payments or card details when you book.
policies.taxesBody: Prices are shown per night before taxes. A service charge of {service}%, a tourism fee of {tourism}% and VAT of {vat}% are added as separate lines on your quote and on your bill.
policies.fourWdBody: A 4WD vehicle is required by the police checkpoint at Birkat Al Mouz. Guests without a 4WD can park at the checkpoint and arrange a transfer with us in advance.

footer.payAtHotelBody: We never ask for card details online. Your room is held on your name and you settle at check-in.
